title: Dialectica Named Growth Winner at the 8th Growth Awards 2025 in Greece
summary: Dialectica was selected as one of six Growth Winners at the 8th Growth Awards 2025, organized by Eurobank and Grant Thornton. The award recognized Dialectica among 8,000 Greek companies for embedding innovation and growth into its core business strategy.
whyItMatters: Multiple growth awards reinforce Dialectica's rapid expansion narrative.
